rows.section: Check selection page for producer, reached by selecting PRNs/PERNs on the list page and choosing 'Accept selected PRNs and PERNs'. Lists the selected PRNs/PERNs in one table per material with a total tonnage row, and lets the user remove any from the selection. Material table headings come from prns.checkSelection.material, with paper and fibre-based composite PRNs sharing the paper table. Accept submits every selected PRN/PERN.
